name: dsh-codex-canvas
description: DeepSeek Harness tool plugin: image generation (gpt-image-2) via the Codex CLI

comments.runtime-deps: Deliberately none: @deepseek-ai/* resolve at runtime through the profile parent-walk to the dsh installation fallback (~/.dsh/profiles/node_modules), which is healed to the SAME dsh version as the running CLI. Bundling npm copies here would mix an old dsh-tools/dsh-jobs runtime with the new registry and break (observed: 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading prepare)').
